*The closing AI beat: verification turned on your own learning.*

::: {.callout-note}
## Draft stub — planned contents
You have learned something when you can do it or explain it with the assistant switched off. Frames this as the test that separates augmenting from cheating, and as the reason the course insists on SOLO work and honest attribution. Sends the student back to the logbook to judge their own progress across the term.
:::
